goal: Find Recipe: Vial of the Sands through Canopic Jars

reset: cast the owned Tol Barad teleport
travel_policy.from_orgrimmar: use the flight master or Ramkahen portal according to the active digsite
travel_policy.site_priority: prefer Uldum when assigned; otherwise clear a reachable Kalimdor site
travel_policy.within_site: try visible GatherMate minimap markers first; use fresh telescope bearings when marker attempts repeat without a find
travel_policy.repeat: reassess active digsites after the completed site's final find is looted

dig_policy.fallback_lifetime: until a confirmed find is looted or the digsite changes
dig_policy.new_marker_learning: let GatherMate record the successfully looted find through its normal addon events

solve_policy.keystones: confirmed maximum accepted socket count from existing bags
solve_policy.races: all races, to avoid wasting capped fragments

display: private Gamescope X display and EI socket
observation_sources: optional passive authenticated visible Survey telescope observations
